title: ED seizure documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports documentation of seizure clusters or convulsive emergencies and a clinician-agreed individual emergency management plan without mapping emergency medication or doses.
user_facing_items.population: Children, young people, and adults with suspected or established epilepsy.
user_facing_items.setting: Primary, specialist, emergency, and ongoing epilepsy care.
restrictions: Exact for epilepsy assessment, monitoring, information, emergency planning, and risk review; international only and local driving, referral, and prescribing rules require UAE review.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports seizure-event and witness history, physical examination, ECG or metabolic context, EEG review, MRI review, recurrence after remission, and specialist assessment.
